items.exampleEn: There is a small clinic next to the school.
items.exampleZh: 學校旁邊有一間小診所。

items.exampleEn: This medicine is only sold with a prescription.
The hotel has a fitness room on the top floor.
items.exampleZh: 飯店頂樓有一間健身房。

items.exampleEn: Many students were absent because of the flu.
items.exampleZh: 很多學生因為流感請假。

items.exampleEn: A new yoga studio opened near the station.
items.exampleZh: 車站附近新開了一間瑜伽教室。

items.exampleEn: The pharmacy on the corner is open until ten.
You can disable the sound on your phone in the settings.
items.exampleZh: 你可以在設定裡關閉手機的聲音。

items.exampleEn: These new shoes hurt my left foot.
items.exampleZh: 這雙新鞋讓我的左腳很痛。

items.exampleEn: The hospital offers free treatment to children.
items.exampleZh: 這家醫院為兒童提供免費治療。

items.sentenceEn: The clinic opens at nine on Saturdays.
items.sentenceZh: 這間診所星期六九點開門。

items.audioEn: Our yoga class moves to Room 5 next week because the floor in Room 2 is being fixed.
items.audioZh: 因為 2 號教室的地板在修，我們的瑜伽課下週改到 5 號教室。
items.questionZh: 下週的瑜伽課在哪裡上？

items.sentenceEn: Wash your hands often during flu season.
My little brother can stand on one foot for a minute.
items.sentenceZh: 我弟弟可以單腳站一分鐘。

items.stemEn: You can buy medicine at the ____ next to the station.
items.stemZh: 你可以在車站旁邊的藥局買藥。

items.stemEn: This button will ____ the alarm for ten minutes.
items.stemZh: 這個按鈕會讓警報停用十分鐘。

items.passageEn: Last winter, Rosa caught the flu and stayed home for a week. When she felt better, she visited a small clinic near her apartment, and the doctor wrote her a prescription. She picked up the medicine at the pharmacy downstairs. Later, to improve her fitness, she joined a yoga class. The teacher showed her how to stand on one foot. She also gets treatment for her back once a month. She takes public transport to the class because parking is hard to find.
items.passageZh: 去年冬天，Rosa 得了流感，在家休息了一個星期。好一點之後，她去了公寓附近的一間小診所，醫生幫她開了處方。她在樓下的藥局拿了藥。後來，為了增強體能，她報名了瑜伽課。老師教她怎麼單腳站立。她每個月也會去做一次背部的治療。她搭大眾運輸去上課，因為停車位很難找。

questions.questionZh: Rosa 為什麼參加瑜伽課？

items.promptZh: 我得了流感，今天不能去上班。
referenceEn: I have the flu, so I can't go to work today.
I've got the flu and can't go to work today.
rubricZh: flu 表示「流感」，例如 have the flu、get the flu 等說法
「不能去上班」可寫，例如 can't go to work 等
時態配合內容（多用現在式）

items.instructionZh: 用 yoga 造一個句子，說說你做瑜伽的習慣或看法。
referenceEn: I do yoga for twenty minutes before bed.
I think yoga is a good way to relax.
rubricZh: yoga 表示「瑜伽」，是不可數名詞，例如 do yoga、a yoga class 等說法
說的是自己的習慣或看法（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式、現在完成式等）
